questions.question: The Science field says "at least one course from three of the following four areas" and then lists six areas (Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Biology, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Physics). Which areas count, and is it three of them?
Science asks for 12 credits "at 200-level or above". Under the current numbering, does that mean 2000-level and above, or 300-level and above?

Three of the four Diversity/Specialty strands are 9 credits of endorsement or minor courses that the record does not list. Which courses count for the Bilingual Education, TESOL and Special Education strands?

How do the 24 credits of the concentration-teaching field count against the rest of the degree? Language Arts repeats core courses (COMM 1130, ENGL 1110, ENGL 1120, LING 2110), and the 19 additional credits name the concentration among the requirements they meet.
